name: 01 - Order Placed

nodes.name: Supabase Webhook: payments update (status=success)
nodes.notes: Configure as a Supabase Database Webhook on payments (UPDATE OF status), firing only when the new status is 'success' -- see the n8n_payment_success trigger in supabase/migrations/00000000000025_n8n_trigger_conditions.sql. Previously fired on orders INSERT, which happens before the payment outcome is known -- a failed payment still notified the vendor of a 'new order' that was cancelled moments later. See docs/n8n-webhook-setup.md.

nodes.name: Notify Restaurant (write notification row)
nodes.notes: Calls the internal route added in this plan's Task 3, which writes a real public.notifications row -- see docs/n8n-webhook-setup.md for APP_BASE_URL/N8N_INTERNAL_SECRET env requirements inside the n8n container.

_note: Originally verified live 2026-09-28 (Task 9 of the checkout-payment-details plan) triggered by orders-INSERT. Re-pointed 2026-09-29 after a live debugging session found a real bug: firing on orders-INSERT notified the vendor of a 'new order' for orders that then failed payment and were cancelled seconds later, since payment hadn't resolved yet at insert time. Now fires on payments UPDATE OF status WHEN status='success' instead (see supabase/migrations/00000000000025_n8n_trigger_conditions.sql), so the vendor is only notified once payment has actually succeeded. Not yet re-verified live against a real n8n instance after this change -- do that before trusting it the way the original orders-INSERT wiring was trusted.
